---
title: "Differential expression: GROUP_A vs GROUP_B"
format:
  html:
    code-fold: true
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: true
  message: false
  warning: false
---

<!--
Purpose: Volcano plot and interactive results table for one DESeq2 contrast.
Inputs:  de_file - a DESeq2 results table (CSV); column names are mapped via the *_col settings
Outputs: rendered HTML with a genes-by-direction table, a labelled volcano plot (also saved as a
         PDF), and an interactive (DT) table of all tested genes
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: settings
#| code-summary: "Code - Define parameters"
de_file <- "DESEQ2_RESULTS.csv"
numerator <- "GROUP_A"
denominator <- "GROUP_B"
project_name <- "PROJECT_NAME"

# Column names in de_file; set an optional one to "" if the table lacks it.
id_col <- "ID"
symbol_col <- "Symbol"
basemean_col <- "baseMean"
lfc_col <- "log2FoldChange"
lfcse_col <- "lfcSE"
stat_col <- "stat"
pvalue_col <- "pvalue"
padj_col <- "padj"

padj_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 1
n_labels <- 5

up_color <- "#008300"
down_color <- "#6250d6"
ns_color <- "#c3c2b7"

volcano_pdf <- str_c(tools::file_path_sans_ext(de_file), "_volcano.pdf")
```

::: {.lead}
Project: `r project_name`\
`r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`\
Lab: Bioinformatics Resource Center
:::

```{r}
#| label: load
#| code-summary: "Code - Load DESeq2 results"
de_raw <- read_csv(de_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: prep
#| code-summary: "Code - Classify genes and pick labels"
up_label <- str_glue("Up in {numerator}")
down_label <- str_glue("Down in {numerator}")

direction_colors <- c(down_color, ns_color, up_color)
names(direction_colors) <- c(down_label, "Not significant", up_label)

# Map whatever the input calls its columns onto fixed names; optional columns that are absent
# (e.g. no symbol or lfcSE) are simply skipped.
col_map <- c(
  ID = id_col,
  Symbol = symbol_col,
  baseMean = basemean_col,
  log2FoldChange = lfc_col,
  lfcSE = lfcse_col,
  stat = stat_col,
  pvalue = pvalue_col,
  padj = padj_col
)
col_map <- col_map[!is.na(col_map) & col_map != "" & col_map %in% names(de_raw)]

de_std <- de_raw %>%
  select(all_of(col_map))

if (!"Symbol" %in% names(de_std)) {
  de_std <- mutate(de_std, Symbol = ID)
}

# Genes with NA padj were removed by DESeq2's independent filtering / outlier detection; they
# carry no testable significance, so they are dropped rather than plotted as non-significant.
de_plot <- de_std %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange), !is.na(stat)) %>%
  mutate(
    Symbol = coalesce(Symbol, ID),
    abs_stat = abs(stat),
    direction = case_when(
      padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange >= lfc_cutoff ~ up_label,
      padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cutoff ~ down_label,
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c(down_label, "Not significant", up_label))
  )

top_genes <- de_plot %>%
  filter(direction != "Not significant") %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  slice_max(abs_stat, n = n_labels, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Genes by direction

```{r}
#| label: direction_counts
#| code-summary: "Code - Count genes by direction"
direction_counts <- de_plot %>%
  count(direction, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    swatch = direction_colors[as.character(direction)],
    Direction = as.character(
      str_glue("<span style=\"color: {swatch}; font-weight: bold;\">{direction}</span>")
    ),
    Genes = scales::comma(n),
    `% of tested` = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
  )

total_row <- tibble(
  Direction = "<b>Total tested</b>",
  Genes = scales::comma(sum(direction_counts$n)),
  `% of tested` = "100%"
)

direction_counts %>%
  select(Direction, Genes, `% of tested`) %>%
  bind_rows(total_row) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c("l", "r", "r"),
    table.attr = "class=\"table table-condensed\" style=\"width: auto;\""
  )
```

## Volcano plot

```{r}
#| label: volcano
#| code-summary: "Code - Draw volcano and save PDF"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
volcano <- ggplot(de_plot, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = abs_stat, color = direction)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(de_plot, direction == "Not significant"), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(de_plot, direction != "Not significant"), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = direction_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = str_glue("{numerator} vs {denominator}"),
    subtitle = str_glue(
      "padj < {padj_cutoff}, |log2FC| ≥ {lfc_cutoff} ({2^lfc_cutoff}-fold)"
    ),
    x = str_glue("log2 fold change ({numerator} / {denominator})"),
    y = "|Wald statistic|",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  volcano <- volcano +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = top_genes,
      aes(label = Symbol),
      color = "black",
      fill = "white",
      label.size = 0.2,
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
} else {
  volcano <- volcano +
    geom_label(data = top_genes, aes(label = Symbol), color = "black", fill = "white",
               size = 3, vjust = -0.4, show.legend = FALSE)
}

# cairo_pdf can encode the "≥" in the subtitle; the base pdf device can't and substitutes dots.
if (capabilities("cairo")) {
  pdf_device <- cairo_pdf
} else {
  pdf_device <- "pdf"
}
ggsave(volcano_pdf, volcano, device = pdf_device, width = 8, height = 6)

volcano
```

## All results (interactive)

```{r}
#| label: results_table
#| code-summary: "Code - Build results table"
results_table <- de_plot %>%
  select(any_of(c("Symbol", "ID", "direction", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat",
                  "pvalue", "padj"))) %>%
  arrange(padj)

round_cols <- intersect(c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat"), names(results_table))
signif_cols <- intersect(c("pvalue", "padj"), names(results_table))

if (requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {
  DT::datatable(
    results_table,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
    )
  ) %>%
    DT::formatRound(round_cols, digits = 2) %>%
    DT::formatSignif(signif_cols, digits = 3)
} else {
  knitr::kable(head(results_table, 50), digits = 3)
}
```
